wait.title: Wait for Confirmation
wait.description: Wait for our team to review and confirm your reservation. You'll receive a notification once approved

whyChooseUs.title: Why Choose Us
whyChooseUs.description: At Auto rent, we understand that choosing the right car rental service is important. Here's why we stand out from the rest and why we're the perfect choice for your next journey:

brand.name: RentyCar
brand.description: Your trusted partner in luxury car rentals. Experience the thrill of driving premium vehicles with our exceptional service.

aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.description: We are dedicated to providing exceptional service and creating memorable experiences for our clients. Our mission is to make your journey seamless and enjoyable.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To revolutionize the way people experience transportation by providing reliable, comfortable, and efficient services that exceed expectations.

customerSatisfaction.title: Customer Satisfaction
customerSatisfaction.description: We prioritize your needs and ensure every journey is comfortable and enjoyable.

safety.title: Safety First
safety.description: Your safety is our top priority. We maintain the highest standards of vehicle maintenance and driver training.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.description: We are committed to being on time, every time, ensuring you reach your destination as planned.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: We are dedicated to reducing our environmental impact through eco-friendly practices.

locations.title: Our Locations
locations.description: We operate in three beautiful cities across Tunisia, providing exceptional transportation services to both locals and visitors. Discover our locations and the unique experiences each city offers.

sousse.name: Sousse
sousse.description: Sousse, known as the "Pearl of the Sahel," offers a perfect blend of history and modernity. Our service here connects you to the vibrant medina, beautiful beaches, and the bustling city center.

monastir.name: Monastir
monastir.description: Monastir, with its rich history and beautiful coastline, is a perfect destination for both leisure and business. Our service ensures comfortable travel throughout the city and its surroundings.

hammamet.name: Hammamet
hammamet.description: Hammamet, famous for its beautiful beaches and vibrant nightlife, is a top tourist destination. Our service provides reliable transportation to all major attractions and resorts.
